uncited: **Extract Normal Index:** Mask the lower 3 bits of the normal index.
**Extract Texture Index:** Mask the lower 8 bits of the texture index.
**Extract UV Corner:** Mask the lower 2 bits of the corner index.
**Extract Width:** Saturate-subtract 1 from width, then mask the lower 4 bits.
**Extract Height:** Saturate-subtract 1 from height, then mask the lower 4 bits.
**Extract AO:** Clamp AO to a maximum of 3, then mask the lower 2 bits.
**Extract Color Components:** Mask the lower 3 bits of each color channel (R, G, B).
**Combine:** Shift and OR the components into the 32-bit integer.
